entry.title: Edit Anki settings in place and test draft connections
entry.content:
Edit Anki settings in place and test draft connections

Group connections, hide optional authentication, and edit note-type mappings directly in one draft. Test entered connection settings and load their models without changing the active connection. Keep connection, catalog, validation, and save failures distinct and reject stale responses.

Preserve the shared modal shell and dismissal guard. Label the existing local revert action accurately, scope resets to individual settings, and retain field choices when samples or model loading fail.

Validation: 113 Rust tests passed including installed UniDic and Tauri cases; actual Svelte browser checks with a fake backend covered direct saves, draft connection isolation, stale results, authentication retry, catalog failures, legacy optional fields, validation, failed-save recovery, delayed suggestions, and scaled/narrow layouts. Frontend checks/build and formatting passed. Clippy has no new warnings. No real Anki cards, caches, or dictionaries were changed.

entry.title: Make Anki connection port and API key configurable
entry.content:
Make Anki connection port and API key configurable

Persist per-profile connection settings with port 8765 and no API key as defaults. Apply saved settings to all Anki requests and invalidate stale matching work. Add validated port and masked key fields to Anki Settings, and preserve authentication error details.

Validation: 110 Rust tests passed, including installed UniDic and Tauri cases; frontend checks, visibility regression, and production build passed; formatting and diff checks passed; Clippy reports no new warnings against the mining branch or main baselines. No live Anki cards or dictionaries were modified.

entry.title: Trim mining branch to the maintained matching policy
entry.content:
Trim mining branch to the maintained matching policy

Retire the abandoned contextual study, portable export, recorded probes, storage benchmark and obsolete rank-heavy fixtures. Keep the importer, final compiler, source exclusion, provenance and production regressions. The reduced full-source rebuild produces the identical 53,645-record binary.

Build installed reading indexes once, remove the redundant resolver cache and unused reading state, make binary lookup internals private, and invalidate snapshots created during dictionary replacement. Consolidate the policy and reproduction guide.

Validation: 106 Rust tests with required installed UniDic, 20 Python tests, frontend checks and build, nightly formatting, and no new Clippy warnings against main with identical locked dependencies.

entry.title: Fix phrase bounds and preserve preferred word identities
entry.content:
Fix phrase bounds and preserve preferred word identities

Keep promoted phrases out of the source-token iteration and prevent lexical fallback from crossing a precomputed word identity. Preserve documented reading-constrained spelling aliases.

Simplify the card reading index, reuse normalization, flatten dictionary updates, remove obsolete helpers and comments, and refresh the manual guide.

Validation: 108 Rust tests with required UniDic, 27 offline policy tests, frontend checks and build, nightly formatting, and no new Clippy warnings against main.

entry.title: Fix row click dead zones and show uncertainty details on hover
entry.content:
Fix row click dead zones and show uncertainty details on hover

Allow ordinary text wrappers and their padding to select the row while preserving control clicks and text selection. Show uncertainty details on hover or focus and dismiss on leave, blur, Escape or outside pointer interaction.

Verified frontend checks and production build, existing visibility tests, and 19 isolated Edge interaction checks using the production row handler and tooltip component.

entry.title: Precompute preferred kana identities and simplify runtime matching
entry.content:
Precompute preferred kana identities and simplify runtime matching

Select reading/POS preferences offline from JMdict, Jitendex and independent frequency-source kana links. Exclude Yomine-generated Anilist Top 500 from imports, analysis, legacy databases and regression evidence. Remove runtime rank ratios and sentence-context bookkeeping; match using the embedded binary table.

Verified 105 Rust tests with required UniDic, 27 research tests, frontend checks, formatting and no new Clippy warnings versus main. Clean and filtered legacy databases generate identical data. Preserve existing UI and user Markdown files.
